scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.vercel:build:frontend: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=backend && npm run lint:fix --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.prepush: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run vercel:build:frontend && npm test
